name: buyorbye-frontend-tests
description: Frontend testing suite for BuyOrBye application

scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:accessibility && npm run test:performance
scripts.size:check: npm run size:css && npm run size:js
scripts.size:css: stat -f%z static/dist/css/output.css 2>/dev/null | awk '{printf "CSS: %.1f KB\n", $1/1024}' || echo 'CSS file not found'
scripts.size:js: find static/js -name '*.js' -not -path '*/test/*' -exec wc -c {} + | tail -1 | awk '{printf "JS: %.1f KB\n", $1/1024}'
scripts.performance:audit: npm run test:performance && npm run size:check
